blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Rowville in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Find out what a kitchen renovation costs in Rowville in 2026, from budget-friendly refreshes to premium custom builds by Smith & Smith Kitchens.
body: If you are a Rowville homeowner wondering what a kitchen renovation will cost in 2026, you are not alone. Kitchen renovations remain one of the most popular home improvement projects across Melbourne's southeast, and for good reason. A well-designed kitchen adds significant value to your property while making daily life more enjoyable. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, we have been renovating kitchens in Rowville and surrounding suburbs like Ferntree Gully, Oakleigh, and Clayton for over 40 years. Based on our extensive experience, kitchen renovation costs in Rowville typically range from $8,000 for a simple refresh to over $40,000 for a premium custom design with high-end materials and finishes. Understanding these price ranges helps you plan your renovation budget with confidence and set realistic expectations for the scope of work involved.

Several key factors influence the overall cost of your Rowville kitchen renovation. The size of your kitchen is the most obvious consideration, with larger spaces requiring more materials, cabinetry, and labour hours. The quality of materials you choose plays a major role, as engineered stone benchtops cost significantly more than laminate alternatives. Plumbing and electrical work can add to the budget, especially if you are relocating sinks, ovens, or lighting fixtures. Structural changes such as removing or adding walls, extending the kitchen footprint, or altering window placements will also increase costs. Additionally, the complexity of your cabinetry design, including features like soft-close drawers, pull-out panneys, and custom corner solutions, will affect the final price. Our Rowville team provides detailed quotes that break down each cost so you know exactly where your investment is going.

For Rowville homeowners seeking an affordable kitchen update, a budget-friendly renovation focused on cosmetic changes can deliver impressive results without breaking the bank. Replacing benchtops and splashbacks, refreshing cabinet doors and handles, and updating lighting fixtures can transform the look of your kitchen for between $8,000 and $15,000. At this price point, you can expect laminate or timber-look benchtops, ceramic splashbacks, and modern cabinet fronts in a range of colours and finishes. This approach works particularly well for Rowville's many family homes built in the 1980s and 1990s, where the existing kitchen layout is functional but the aesthetics need a modern touch. A smart cosmetic renovation can add thousands to your property's value while giving you a kitchen you are proud to show off.

Mid-range kitchen renovations in Rowville, typically costing between $15,000 and $30,000, offer the best balance of quality, design, and value for most families. At this level, you can expect custom-built cabinetry designed to maximise storage in your specific kitchen footprint, engineered stone benchtops from premium brands, and a stylish glass or tile splashback. This budget also allows for quality appliances, upgraded plumbing fixtures, and professional lighting design. For most Rowville families, a mid-range renovation is the sweet spot because it delivers a genuinely transformative result while remaining a sensible investment. Our team at Smith & Smith Kitchens has completed hundreds of mid-range renovations across Rowville and Melbourne's southeast, and we can guide you toward the best material and design choices for your budget.

Premium kitchen renovations in Rowville, starting from $30,000 and sometimes exceeding $50,000, are for homeowners who want the very best in materials, design, and craftsmanship. At this level, you might choose natural stone benchtops like marble or granite, fully custom cabinetry with specialist finishes, integrated premium appliances, and bespoke lighting solutions. Many of our Rowville clients at this price point also opt for structural changes such as opening the kitchen to the living area, adding a large island bench, or creating a scullery or butler's pantry. While this represents a significant investment, a premium kitchen renovation in Rowville can substantially increase your property's market value and provide decades of daily enjoyment for your entire family.

The best way to determine the exact cost of your Rowville kitchen renovation is to arrange a free, no-obligation consultation with our team at Smith & Smith Kitchens. During this visit, we assess your existing kitchen, discuss your goals and preferences, and provide a detailed, transparent quote with no hidden surprises. We have been renovating kitchens at 889 Wellington Road in Rowville for over 40 years, and our local knowledge means we understand the styles, materials, and layouts that work best in Melbourne's southeast. Whether you are planning a simple refresh or a complete custom transformation, contact us on (03) 9755 4888 to start your kitchen renovation journey today.

blogPosts.title: Best Benchtop Materials for Melbourne Kitchens: A Rowville Homeowner Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Compare the best benchtop materials for your Rowville kitchen renovation, including engineered stone, laminate, marble, timber, and more.
body: Choosing the right benchtop material is one of the most important decisions you will make during your Rowville kitchen renovation. Your benchtop is the workhorse of the kitchen, enduring daily use from food preparation, hot pans, sharp knives, and spills. It is also the visual centrepiece that ties your entire kitchen design together. With so many options available on the Melbourne market, from affordable laminates to luxurious natural stones, making the right choice can feel overwhelming. At Smith & Smith Kitchens in Rowville, we have installed thousands of benchtops across Melbourne's southeast over our 40 years in business. In this guide, we break down the most popular benchtop materials, their pros and cons, and what they cost so you can make an informed decision for your home.

Engineered stone, including popular brands like Caesarstone and Silestone, has become the most sought-after benchtop material for Rowville kitchen renovations, and for very good reason. Made from crushed natural quartz mixed with resin, engineered stone offers the beauty of natural stone without the maintenance headaches. It is non-porous, which means it resists staining from wine, coffee, and cooking oils, and it does not require sealing like natural marble or granite. Available in a huge range of colours and patterns, from classic whites to dramatic veined designs, engineered stone suits virtually any kitchen style. For Rowville homeowners, the cost of engineered stone benchtops typically ranges from $400 to $700 per square metre installed, making it a mid-range option that delivers exceptional value and longevity for Melbourne families who want a premium look without the premium maintenance.

Laminate benchtops remain a popular and budget-friendly choice for Rowville kitchen renovations, especially for families working within a tighter budget. Modern laminates have come a long way from the dated patterns of decades past, now offering convincing stone and timber looks at a fraction of the price. Brands like Laminex and Formica produce high-quality laminate sheets that are durable, easy to clean, and available in dozens of colours and textures. The cost of laminate benchtops in Melbourne typically ranges from $150 to $350 per square metre installed, making them ideal for rental properties, investment renovations, or budget-conscious homeowners. While laminate does not have the same premium feel as stone, a well-chosen modern laminate can look surprisingly elegant and serve your Rowville kitchen reliably for many years.

Natural stone benchtops, particularly marble and granite, offer unmatched beauty and a sense of luxury that no other material can replicate. Marble, with its distinctive veining and soft elegance, has been a symbol of refined taste for centuries. However, it is a porous material that requires regular sealing and can be susceptible to etching from acidic foods like lemon juice and vinegar. Granite, on the other hand, is one of the hardest natural stones available and offers excellent resistance to heat and scratches, though it also requires periodic sealing. For Rowville homeowners considering natural stone, expect to pay between $500 and $1,000 or more per square metre installed. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, we help our Rowville clients understand the maintenance requirements of natural stone so they can decide if the aesthetic payoff is worth the ongoing care.

For Rowville homeowners seeking something different, timber and concrete benchtops offer distinctive alternatives that bring warmth and character to a kitchen. Butcher block timber benchtops, made from strips of hardwood joined together, create a warm, natural look that works beautifully in farmhouse and contemporary kitchens alike. Timber requires regular oiling to maintain its appearance and protect against moisture, but many homeowners find the natural patina that develops over time adds to its charm. Concrete benchtops, while less common in Melbourne, offer an industrial aesthetic that pairs well with modern and minimalist designs. Both materials typically cost between $300 and $600 per square metre installed. Our team at Smith & Smith Kitchens can show you timber and concrete samples at our Rowville showroom to help you find the perfect match for your renovation.

Ultimately, the best benchtop material for your Rowville kitchen depends on your lifestyle, budget, and design preferences. If you have young children and need a low-maintenance surface that resists stains and scratches, engineered stone is likely your best option. If budget is your primary concern, modern laminates offer surprising style at an affordable price. If you want timeless luxury and are willing to invest in maintenance, natural stone will elevate your kitchen to another level. Visit the Smith & Smith Kitchens showroom at 889 Wellington Road in Rowville to see and touch our full range of benchtop materials in person. Our experienced design team will help you compare options and select the perfect surface for your Melbourne kitchen renovation. Call (03) 9755 4888 to book your free consultation today.

blogPosts.title: How to Choose the Perfect Cabinetry for Your Rowville Kitchen Renovation
blogPosts.excerpt: Expert advice on selecting kitchen cabinetry for your Rowville renovation, covering materials, styles, layouts, and smart storage solutions.
body: Cabinetry is the backbone of any kitchen renovation, and choosing the right style, material, and configuration can make or break your Rowville kitchen's functionality and appearance. In fact, cabinetry typically accounts for 40 to 50 percent of a kitchen renovation budget, making it the single most important investment in your project. Whether you prefer sleek handleless designs, classic shaker profiles, or something entirely custom, the decisions you make about your cabinets will shape how your kitchen looks and performs for decades to come. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, we have been designing and building custom cabinetry in our Rowville workshop for over 40 years. In this guide, we share our expert advice on selecting cabinetry that perfectly suits your Rowville home, lifestyle, and budget.

The first decision you need to make when choosing kitchen cabinetry is the material. For Rowville kitchen renovations, the most common options are melamine-faced particleboard, timber veneer, and solid timber. Melamine is the most affordable choice and is available in a wide range of colours and finishes, making it suitable for most budgets and styles. Timber veneer offers the authentic look of real wood with a thinner layer of timber bonded to a stable substrate, providing a premium appearance at a lower cost than solid timber. Solid timber cabinetry, while the most expensive option, delivers unmatched warmth, character, and longevity. For most Rowville families, a combination of melamine for upper cabinets and timber veneer for feature elements like an island bench provides the ideal balance of quality and value. Our workshop in Rowville can craft all three options to your exact specifications.

The layout and configuration of your cabinetry is equally important as the material, especially in Rowville's diverse range of kitchen sizes and shapes. L-shaped kitchens, which are common in many Rowville homes built during the 1980s and 1990s, benefit from cabinetry that maximises corner space with solutions like lazy Susans, corner carousels, or pull-out corner units. Galley kitchens, often found in smaller Rowville townhouses, require tall, narrow cabinetry that makes the most of limited floor space. U-shaped kitchens offer the most storage and bench space but require careful planning to ensure traffic flow remains comfortable. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, our designers visit your Rowville home to measure your kitchen precisely and create a cabinetry layout that optimises every centimetre. We use advanced design software to show you exactly how your new cabinetry will look before we begin building.

Cabinet door styles define the overall aesthetic of your Rowville kitchen, and there are several popular options to consider. Shaker-style doors, with their recessed centre panel and clean lines, remain the most popular choice in Melbourne and work beautifully in both traditional and contemporary kitchens. Flat-panel or handleless doors create a sleek, minimalist look that is perfect for modern Rowville homes and small kitchens where visual simplicity makes the space feel larger. Profiled doors with decorative mouldings suit heritage and classic-style homes and add a sense of timeless elegance. At Smith & Smith Kitchens in Rowville, we offer all of these styles and can customise dimensions, colours, and finishes to match your exact vision. Our showroom at 889 Wellington Road displays dozens of door styles and finishes so you can see and feel the quality before making your decision.

Inside your cabinets, smart storage solutions can transform how you use your Rowville kitchen every single day. Soft-close drawer runners and hinges are now considered standard in quality kitchen renovations, preventing slamming and extending the life of your cabinetry. Pull-out pantry units bring contents within easy reach, eliminating the frustration of deep, dark cupboards where items get lost. Drawer dividers, cutlery trays, and utensil organisers keep everything neat and accessible. For corner cabinets, which are notoriously difficult to use efficiently, options like magic corner units, carousel shelves, and kidney-shaped pull-outs make every bit of storage space usable. Spice racks, knife blocks, and waste bin pull-outs are additional custom touches that elevate your kitchen's functionality. At our Rowville workshop, we can incorporate all of these solutions into your custom cabinetry design to create a kitchen that works as beautifully as it looks.

The colour and finish of your cabinetry sets the tone for your entire Rowville kitchen, and current trends in Melbourne offer plenty of inspiring options. White and off-white remain perennially popular for their bright, clean appearance, though they do require more maintenance to keep looking fresh. Navy blue and deep green have surged in popularity for island benches and feature cabinetry, adding drama and personality to otherwise neutral kitchens. Two-tone designs, combining dark lower cabinets with lighter uppers, create visual interest and make ceilings appear higher. For finishes, matte surfaces are currently trending over high-gloss, offering a sophisticated, contemporary feel that is also more forgiving with fingerprints and smudges. Visit Smith & Smith Kitchens at 889 Wellington Road in Rowville to explore our full range of cabinetry colours and finishes. Our design team will help you create a colour palette that reflects your personal style and complements your Rowville home's existing decor.

blogPosts.title: Kitchen Lighting Design Ideas for Melbourne Homes: Tips from Rowville Experts
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover expert kitchen lighting design tips for your Rowville renovation, from task lighting and pendants to smart LED solutions.
body: Lighting is one of the most overlooked yet impactful elements of a kitchen renovation, and getting it right can completely transform how your Rowville kitchen looks and feels. Good kitchen lighting serves three essential purposes: task lighting for food preparation areas, ambient lighting for general illumination, and accent lighting to highlight architectural features and create atmosphere. Poor lighting can make even the most beautifully designed kitchen feel dark and unwelcoming, while a well-planned lighting scheme enhances every other element of your renovation. At Smith & Smith Kitchens in Rowville, we have been integrating thoughtful lighting design into our kitchen renovations for over 40 years. In this guide, we share our expert tips for creating the perfect lighting plan for your Melbourne kitchen, from practical task lighting to stunning feature pendants that make a statement.

Task lighting is the foundation of any effective kitchen lighting plan, and it is especially important in Rowville homes where kitchens often serve as the central hub of family life. Under-cabinet LED strip lighting is the gold standard for task illumination, casting bright, even light directly onto your benchtops where you do most of your food preparation. This type of lighting eliminates shadows cast by overhead fixtures and upper cabinets, making chopping, reading recipes, and detailed kitchen work much easier and safer. LED strip lights are energy-efficient, long-lasting, and available in various colour temperatures from warm white to cool daylight. For Rowville homeowners, the cost of quality under-cabinet LED lighting typically ranges from $200 to $500 installed, making it one of the most cost-effective upgrades in any kitchen renovation. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, we include under-cabinet lighting in all of our standard kitchen renovation packages for our Rowville clients.

Pendant lighting has become a defining feature of modern Melbourne kitchens, and Rowville homeowners are embracing this trend with enthusiasm. A row of three matching pendants over an island bench or dining area creates a striking visual focal point while providing excellent task lighting for casual dining and food preparation. The style of pendant you choose should complement your overall kitchen design: industrial-style metal pendants suit contemporary kitchens, glass pendants add elegance to traditional spaces, and woven or rattan pendants bring warmth to coastal and bohemian-inspired designs. When hanging pendants over a kitchen island, the ideal height is approximately 700 to 800 millimetres above the benchtop surface, with at least 600 millimetres between each pendant to avoid a cluttered look. Our team at Smith & Smith Kitchens in Rowville can recommend and install pendant lighting that perfectly complements your new kitchen design and creates the atmosphere you are after.

Recessed downlights and ceiling-mounted fixtures provide the ambient lighting that forms the base layer of your Rowville kitchen's lighting scheme. LED downlights are the most popular choice for Melbourne kitchens because they provide bright, even illumination while consuming minimal energy and lasting up to 50,000 hours. The general recommendation is to space downlights approximately 1.5 to 2 metres apart to achieve consistent coverage without creating dark spots or harsh shadows. For kitchens larger than 12 square metres, which is common in Rowville's family homes, you will typically need between six and ten downlights for adequate ambient illumination. Dimmer switches are a worthwhile addition that allows you to adjust brightness levels for different times of day and occasions, from bright morning light for breakfast preparation to soft evening ambiance for entertaining. At our Rowville showroom, we can demonstrate different lighting options and help you create a layered lighting plan that makes your kitchen both functional and inviting.

Smart lighting technology is rapidly gaining popularity in Melbourne kitchen renovations, and Rowville homeowners are increasingly asking us about integrated lighting control systems. Smart LED bulbs and strips can be controlled via smartphone apps or voice assistants like Google Home and Amazon Alexa, allowing you to adjust brightness, colour temperature, and even colour with a simple voice command. Some systems offer preset scenes such as Cooking, Dining, and Entertaining that automatically adjust multiple light sources to suit different activities. Colour-changing LED strips behind kickboards or inside glass-front cabinets can add a dramatic design element that sets your Rowville kitchen apart. While smart lighting does involve a higher upfront investment, typically adding $500 to $1,500 to your renovation budget, the convenience and flexibility it offers make it an increasingly popular choice among tech-savvy homeowners in Melbourne's southeast. At Smith & Smith Kitchens, we stay current with the latest lighting technology to offer our Rowville clients the most innovative solutions available.

Planning your kitchen lighting should happen early in the renovation process, ideally during the initial design phase rather than as an afterthought. This is because lighting placement affects where power points are installed, where cables are routed, and how cabinetry is configured. At Smith & Smith Kitchens in Rowville, our design team creates a detailed lighting plan as part of every kitchen renovation project, mapping out the position and type of each light fixture in relation to your cabinetry, appliances, and work zones. We work closely with licensed electricians to ensure all lighting installations meet Australian safety standards and are positioned for maximum effectiveness. During your free consultation at our 889 Wellington Road showroom, we can walk you through lighting options, demonstrate different fixtures in our display kitchen, and help you build a lighting plan that brings your Rowville kitchen to life. Contact us on (03) 9755 4888 to start planning your kitchen renovation today.
